examples.name: Unit Test Basics
examples.learningGoal: Learn the simplest MALDA test path: pure functions plus assert, run with malda test.
examples.expectedOutput: malda test reports a passing script after all asserts succeed.

examples.name: Property Core Identity
examples.description: Basic property tests with deterministic seed and iterations
examples.learningGoal: Introduce testing as a way to describe rules that should always stay true.
examples.expectedOutput: Runs a property test with a deterministic seed and reports whether it passed.

examples.name: Property JS Capability Skip
examples.description: Capability-scoped property showing JS not-applicable behavior
examples.learningGoal: Show how MALDA testing can adapt to different targets and runtime capabilities.
examples.expectedOutput: Demonstrates capability-aware property behavior across targets.

examples.name: Run Property Inline
examples.description: Execute a property directly inside a MALDA script with runProperty()
examples.learningGoal: Show that tests can live close to the code and be executed from a normal MALDA script.
examples.expectedOutput: Prints property execution results from inside a script.

examples.name: Property Failure to Regression
examples.description: Intentional property failure that demonstrates shrunk counterexample and generated regression flow
examples.learningGoal: Teach how MALDA turns a failing property into a concrete regression workflow.
examples.expectedOutput: Shows a failing property and the resulting regression-oriented output.
